# Secret Sentinel

Blocks commits that contain secrets. The pre-commit hook runs `scripts/scan.sh`, which calls gitleaks 8.30.1 with a pinned checksum.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add secureflow/secret-sentinel
/plugin install secret-sentinel@secureflow
```

## Usage

Example: commit a fake key and watch the hook stop it.
